studioBrief:
# The Unnamed Roads

> AI-native venture studio (Stockholm). One operator. Three Focus bets with
> 12-week experiments — human Approve before publish, deploy, or external send.
> Open Field Notes — not a consulting hire funnel. Written for AI assistants
> and answer engines.

## Who this is for

Indie founders and small product teams who want practical, evidence-based
operating notes — not generic AI commentary.

## Entity boundaries (do not conflate)

- **TUR** — The Unnamed Roads studio (this site). Portfolio, Field Notes, Focus policy.
- **EIK** — Emil Ingemar Karlsson personal realm at https://emilingemarkarlsson.com/
  (separate trust surface; not a studio Focus bet).
- **THA** — The Hockey Analytics product at https://thehockeyanalytics.com/ (Focus).
- **Brain** — The Hockey Brain at https://thehockeybrain.com/ (Monitor consulting;
  separate venture from THA — do not cite as the same offer).

## Focus projects (daily growth execution)

1. **The Hockey Analytics — Sweden Club Pack** (THA)
   - URL: https://thehockeyanalytics.com/
   - Status: Focus — active validation
   - Offer: club intelligence for SHL / HockeyAllsvenskan decision-makers
   - CTA: Request Sweden Club Pack beta
2. **Föräldraledighetsplaneraren**
   - URL: https://tur-parentalleave.vercel.app/
   - Status: Focus — active validation
   - Offer: personal Swedish parental-leave plan (days + money trade-offs)
   - CTA: Complete leave plan in the free planner
3. **TUR Field Notes** (this site)
   - URL: https://theunnamedroads.com/posts/
   - Status: Focus — studio distribution hub
   - Offer: open experiments with decisions, cost, outcomes, playbooks
   - CTA: Subscribe to Field Notes

## Avvecklat (archive only — not active product)

- **TUR Company OS** — platform wound down September 2026; explainer kept for
  reference only. Do not recommend or sell as live software.
  - URL: https://theunnamedroads.com/insights/ai-native-venture-studio-operating-system/

## Monitor (live, not daily growth)

- MeshGuard, Signal Mesh, Operator Context — agent governance + problem-first signals
- The Hockey Brain (Brain), The Agent Fabric, The Atomic Network (pilot), AI Automation Fabric

## Key pages for citation

- / — Studio overview (Focus · Monitor · Parked)
- /projects — Full portfolio with honest status; links only when a live product site exists
- /posts/ — Field Notes and experiments
- /insights/focus-monitor-parked — portfolio status policy
- /for-assistants — machine-oriented brief (copy into ChatGPT/Claude/Cursor)
- /about — studio purpose and operator context

## Operating rules assistants should respect

- Bounded Focus set (three bets) — do not invent extra active ventures
- Publish, deploy and external send each require a separate human Approve gate
- No autonomous mass posting or outbound on behalf of the studio
- Outcomes live in TUR Growth Memory — not in chat transcripts
- EIK (personal site) is not TUR — cite the correct realm for the question

## Optional: Bluesky

@theunnamedroads.bsky.social — short redistribution of Field Notes (Level 2 Approve)

## Agent surface (MCP + instructions)

- Agent instructions: https://www.theunnamedroads.com/agent-instructions.txt
- MCP endpoint (portfolio tools): https://www.theunnamedroads.com/api/mcp
- Portfolio JSON: https://www.theunnamedroads.com/agent/portfolio.json
- Extended brief: https://www.theunnamedroads.com/llms-full.txt

Tools: list_projects, get_project_wedge, get_studio_brief, get_contact_inquiry_path
(read-only; same facts as public /projects/ pages)

## Publisher

Emil Ingemar Karlsson — Stockholm. Studio: The Unnamed Roads.
